title: Dimension invariance in intuitionistic primitive recursive arithmetic
subtitle: A finite proof using staggered rational grids

deliverable_status.human_readable_mathematical_proof: complete argument in dimension_invariance.tex and its compiled PDF
deliverable_status.lean_formalization: unfinished documentation-only blueprint; proposed declarations are comments, not proved theorems
deliverable_status.python_status: exact-rational executable witness extraction and finite validation; not an iPRA or Lean proof certificate

theorem_scope.finite_theorem: For d>0, N>=1, h>0, a rational table F:{0,...,N}^d->Q^m with opposite-face distances at least h and each Kuhn-simplex image diameter strictly below h/d satisfies d<=m. The d=0 conclusion is immediate.
theorem_scope.positive_alternative: For d>m, bounded extraction returns either an opposite-face pair with image distance below h or a Kuhn-simplex pair with image distance at least h/d.
theorem_scope.map_corollary: Approximate opposite-face collisions and dimension invariance for fixed primitive-recursive rational evaluators with the explicitly supplied uniformity and inverse data.
theorem_scope.arithmetic_boundary: The finite assertion is a first-order numerical theorem. Infinite map presentations are treated as a schema for fixed primitive-recursive procedures, not as unrestricted function quantification or a universal primitive-recursive evaluator.
